label: 18 November 2026
title: Training without full internationals; Mendes meets Balde; Cubarsí remains a doubt
deck: Barcelona trained at the Ciutat Esportiva on Tuesday still without the full international group. Dani Olmo worked with the squad. Jules Koundé continued separate. Pau Cubarsí and Frenkie de Jong did specific work. Jorge Mendes met Alejandro Balde in Barcelona. Villarreal visit Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday at 14:00.

stories.headline: Squad trains without full internationals; Olmo with the group, Koundé separate
stories.summary: Barcelona trained at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper on Tuesday. Hansi Flick did not yet have the full international group. Dani Olmo completed part of the collective session. Jules Koundé worked apart while recovering from his left-ankle sprain. Pau Cubarsí and Frenkie de Jong did specific work.
stories.body: Mundo Deportivo reported that the session prepared the side for Villarreal on Sunday 22 November (14:00) at Spotify Camp Nou. The internationals are due back for Thursday’s training after a rest day on Wednesday. Rodri, Xavi Espart and Roony Bardghji remain out. Koundé’s progress will be monitored through the week to see whether he can be considered for the Villarreal match. Olmo, out since the PSG game in October with an adductor injury, continues his return plan and is aiming for the weekend.

stories.headline: Mendes meets Balde in Barcelona to discuss the left-back’s future
stories.summary: Jorge Mendes arrived in Barcelona on Tuesday and met Alejandro Balde. Mundo Deportivo said the conversation covered Balde’s limited minutes under Hansi Flick and the possibility of a January move. No formal offer is on the table. PSG and Juventus have been linked.
stories.body: Balde has played roughly 124 minutes across five appearances this season. Mendes also spent time with Lamine Yamal during the short visit. SPORT reported the agent landed around 13:00 at El Prat. The club would look for a fee near 40 million euros for a permanent exit, according to Spanish reports. A loan has also been discussed in Italian coverage. Mendes is expected to speak with the sporting department while the January window approaches. Balde remains under contract until 30 June 2028.

stories.headline: Cubarsí remains a doubt for Villarreal after iliopsoas overload
stories.summary: Pau Cubarsí continues with specific work after the iliopsoas overload confirmed on Monday. The club said his evolution will decide availability for Villarreal on 22 November. He was taken off at half-time in Spain’s defeat to England.
stories.body: Barcelona’s medical staff assessed him at the Ciutat Esportiva on Monday. No fixed return date has been given. If he misses Sunday, the next fixtures are the Champions League trip to Sabah on 25 November and the visit to Deportivo on 29 November. Eric García, Andreas Christensen and possibly De Jong remain the centre-back options if Cubarsí is unavailable. Koundé and Espart are still out of the group.

stories.headline: De Jong available for Villarreal after obturator stretch
stories.summary: Frenkie de Jong has an obturator stretch but will be available for Villarreal. He missed the Netherlands match against Germany after returning early from the camp. Barcelona confirmed the diagnosis on Monday.
stories.body: Xavi Hernández had already left him out of the Berlin fixture. Tests by the Dutch federation and Barcelona’s staff agreed on the nature of the problem. He is expected to start on the bench and be managed carefully after the international window. De Jong has been used in several midfield and defensive roles this season, including centre-back against Alavés.

stories.headline: Olmo continues group work and aims for Villarreal
stories.summary: Dani Olmo trained with the group again on Tuesday. He has been out since the PSG match on 20 October with an adductor injury. The club is targeting him for the Villarreal game on Sunday.
stories.body: Olmo completed a portion of the collective session on Monday and continued on Tuesday. The original estimate was roughly a month. His response to the increased load this week will decide whether he is fully available. Flick has a full week of training before Villarreal arrive at Spotify Camp Nou at 14:00. The rest of the available non-internationals also trained normally.

stories.headline: Flick gives Wednesday off; internationals return Thursday
stories.summary: Hansi Flick has given the squad a rest day on Wednesday. Training resumes on Thursday with the return of the internationals. The side then prepares for Villarreal on Sunday.
stories.body: Most of the internationals finish their commitments this week. Raphinha remains with Brazil in Singapore after the friendly against the hosts. The medical staff continue to monitor Cubarsí and Koundé. After Villarreal, Barcelona travel to Sabah in the Champions League on 25 November and visit Deportivo on 29 November. The remaining 2026 home games at Spotify Camp Nou include Atlético, Manchester City, Celta and Real Sociedad.

stories.headline: Barça have won 16 of the last 19 league games after international breaks
stories.summary: Barcelona have won 16 and drawn three of their last 19 matches played immediately after an international window, according to Mundo Deportivo. The run covers the Koeman, Xavi and Flick eras. The last defeat in that situation was a 0-3 loss at Bayern in September 2021.
stories.body: The side go into the Villarreal game having recovered form with the 6-1 win over Alavés, the 3-0 against Aston Villa and the comeback at Atlético. Mundo Deportivo noted that Barcelona have won only 54.5% of matches after the November international break in recent seasons, which is lower than the overall post-window record. Flick will have the full international group available from Thursday onward.

stories.headline: Suárez praises Raphinha’s work as a number nine
stories.summary: Luis Suárez said Raphinha has surprised him in the number-nine role. Mundo Deportivo reported the former Barcelona striker’s comments on Tuesday. Raphinha remains with Brazil in Singapore after seeing red against Japan.
stories.body: Raphinha was suspended for the Singapore friendly but the CBF did not release him early. He is expected back in Barcelona next week and available for Villarreal if there are no further issues. The club and CBF had already agreed to control his workload during this window after he signed a new deal until 2030. Ancelotti has used him in different attacking positions for Brazil.
